lead.suggested_next_step: Read the JD; apply if it fits
lead.jd_excerpt: Strong hands-on experience as a Data Engineer, preferably in the healthcare domain. Expertise in designing and implementing ETL/ELT pipelines and complex data integration workflows. Strong experience with Microsoft Azure data engineering services. Experience with one or more of the following: Azure Data Factory, Azure Databricks, Azure Data Lake Storage, Azure Synapse Analytics, or Microsoft Fabric. Proficiency in SQL and Python for data transformation, automation, and pipeline development. Experience with Apache Spark, PySpark, or other distributed data processing technologies. Understanding of data modeling, data warehousing, lakehouse architecture, and scalable data platforms. Experience preparing and processing data for AI/ML use cases, including feature engineering and ML data pipelines.

fit.why: Houston and the data automation, SQL, Python, Tableau, and AWS pipeline work are relevant, but the resume does not demonstrate the Azure stack, distributed processing, lakehouse architecture, AI/ML data pipelines, or Lead-level depth required for this role.
flags: Azure ecosystem experience is not demonstrated; the documented cloud experience is AWS
Role is substantially more senior and platform-specific than the candidate's documented Associate Data Engineer experience

req_gaps.req: Strong experience with Microsoft Azure data engineering services

req_gaps.req: Experience with one or more of the following: Azure Data Factory, Azure Databricks, Azure Data Lake Storage, Azure Synapse Analytics, or Microsoft Fabric
req_gaps.note: The resume lists AWS, Tableau, Power BI, and Salesforce but does not document any of the specified Azure services.

req_gaps.req: Proficiency in SQL and Python for data transformation, automation, and pipeline development

req_gaps.req: Experience with Apache Spark, PySpark, or other distributed data processing technologies
req_gaps.note: The resume documents Python, C++, SQL, and AWS work but does not mention Spark, PySpark, or distributed data processing.

req_gaps.req: Understanding of data modeling, data warehousing, lakehouse architecture, and scalable data platforms
req_gaps.note: The candidate designed SQL reporting tables and worked with cloud-hosted data, but data modeling, warehousing, and lakehouse architecture are not explicitly documented.

req_gaps.req: Experience preparing and processing data for AI/ML use cases, including feature engineering and ML data pipelines
req_gaps.note: No AI/ML data preparation, feature engineering, or ML pipeline experience is stated in the resume.
